node_definition.done_when:
The plan's §11 is the authority; read it and the model-currency evidence (docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/model-currency.html) first.

Reckon owns the model catalogue: for each backend, the family, model, alias, effort, budget_group and per-million rates. Today these live only in the host layer (/home/ITER/mcintos/Code/dotfiles/reckon/flight.yaml, read-only to you; installed as ~/.config/reckon/flight.yaml). Layer order is shipped < host < project < override (reckon/flight.py LAYER_ORDER), and the shipped layer (reckon/schema/flight-defaults.yaml) defines only the native backend.

1. Table every key under each backends entry (backends.codex, backends.clive and so on) in the current host layer as either catalogue (a reckon decision) or machine fact (placement, paths, commands, credentials, endpoints, launch wrappers). Record the table in docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/model-catalogue-in-reckon.html.
2. Ship the catalogue values that resolve today, for every backend the host layer defines, in a reckon-owned layer. Precedence does not change: a host, project or override value still wins. A catalogue entry alone never creates a backend. A host that does not define codex, for example, must resolve no codex backend, so other workstations and projects see no phantom candidates.
3. reckon flight (and the crew flight view) reports each host-layer value for a catalogue key as shadowing reckon's catalogue, naming the key, the backend and the file. That way the dotfiles layer can be emptied of catalogue keys in a later commit without the resolved values changing.
4. Prove no resolved value changes: the resolved flight for --project reckon, before and after, differs only in provenance for catalogue keys. Capture both as JSON under the run directory and cite the diff in the fragment.

Gate: tests/test_flight*.py, tests/test_routing_picker_key.py, tests/test_routing_picker_default.py and a new tests/test_flight_catalogue_layer.py. The new file covers: a catalogue-only entry creates no backend; a host value wins and is reported as a shadow; with the host catalogue keys removed, the resolved values are unchanged. Run with the main checkout's .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider, one log for base and one for head under the run directory, judged by delta. The coordinator runs the 33-file flight importer population at merge.
